question: Which sacred syllable adorns the beginning of the mantra in this instruction?
premises: That element is the Veda-beginning, the praṇava.
The mantra is adorned and decorated with it at the beginning.
inference: The praṇava adorns the beginning of the mantra.
uncertainties: vedādiḥ is taken as referring to the praṇava in apposition; exact nuance depends on context.
plain_english: The praṇava, the beginning of the Veda, adorns and decorates it at the beginning.
